names.title: Names and areas
names.description: The names are suggestions; change them as you like. Leave a room name empty if that room is not installed: it is then skipped (no device, no entities). Optionally assign each room to a Home Assistant area; rooms without an area are left unchanged. Under "own sensors" you can optionally pick your own CO₂ and humidity sensors per room. Room 1 is the main room; the room number matches the unit's room controller and stays fixed, even if you rename the room.

room_1_sensors.description: CO₂ and humidity sensor of this room, e.g. from another device. Replaces the unit's values in the dashboard.

data_description.filter_interval: Basis of the maintenance bar in the side panel. The unit asks for a change after 180 days and shuts down by force 21 days after that message.
data_description.recirc_filter: Only enable if you have an extra recirculation filter. Otherwise it is hidden in the card and side panel.
data_description.boost_minutes: After this time the previous fan stage is restored automatically.
data_description.outdoor_side: Which side of the unit are fresh air and exhaust air connected to, seen from the front? This turns the diagram in the card and side panel. The supply and extract air are on the opposite side.
data_description.power_entity: Replaces the unit's power consumption in the card and side panel, e.g. a Shelly on the unit. Leave empty to use the unit's sensor.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Replaces the unit's outdoor temperature in the card and side panel. Leave empty to use the unit's sensor.

fan_stage_restore.name: Restore fan stage after heat pump

start_boost.name: Start boost ventilation
start_boost.description: Runs the fan at the highest level and restores the previous state afterwards.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long the boost lasts. Without a value the duration from the integration options is used.

filter_due.title: Change the device filter
filter_due.description: The unit "{name}" asks for a new device filter. It shuts down by force in {days} day(s) if the filter is not replaced. After the change, press the "Filter changed" button (or wait until the unit clears the message).

connection_lost.title: Proxon FWT unreachable
connection_lost.description: The unit "{name}" has not delivered data for more than 10 minutes. Check power, the network or USB connection and the Modbus gateway settings. This notice disappears by itself once the connection works again.

write_failing.title: Proxon FWT rejects commands
write_failing.description: Several write commands to "{name}" failed in a row. The "Last write error" sensor names the register and reason. Common causes: a wrong Modbus address or a gateway in read-only mode. This notice disappears after the next successful write.

boost_unavailable.message: Boost ventilation is not available in the current operating mode

change_not_allowed.message: The unit currently does not allow this change ({flag})

ptc_unknown.message: PTC enable state could not be read; try again shortly

boost_wrong_switch.message: start_boost only works on the boost ventilation switch
